newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mt Leyshon shares leap on merger plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mt Leyshon shares leap on merger plan.

text.p: Shares in gold miner Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd leapt 23 cents to A$2.35 on Thursday following a merger offer made late on Wednesday by fellow gold miner St Barbara Mines Ltd.
The terms of the proposed offer are 32 St Barbara shares for every 10 Mt Leyshon shares. Based on St Barbara's current price of 77 cents, the offer values Mt Leyshon at A$2.46 per share.
Mt Leyshon is 75.6 percent owned by Normandy Mining ltd and brokers said this holding was obviously the key to any merger.
"The offer values Mt Leyshon highly but the key to any deal is Normandy and their stake," said a Sydney-based dealer.
While Mt Leyshon said it was receptive to a merger proposal, it has advised shareholders not to sell ahead of the receipt of formal takeover documents.
By 1.55 p.m. (0255 GMT), Mt Leyshon shares were 23 cents higher at A$2.35 on light trade of 27,957 shares.
St Barbara shares were a cent lower at 77 cents on turnover of 363,842 shares. Normandy shares were steady at A$1.75 on turnover of 9.8 million shares.
